content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Fix GitHub issue #229 in Moneo: the owner has an old bank account that isn't connected. Moneo asked "is this you?" about a transfer to it, and the owner said yes, but then it asked again for each of the other 8–10 transactions with the same account.

Owner's decision: **Remember it as an own untracked account.** On the first "yes, this is mine", save that identifier (IBAN/name) as one of the owner's own untracked accounts (it shows in the Accounts page under accounts Moneo doesn't track), mark every matching transaction, past and future (imports and bank sync), as an own transfer, and never ask about that account again. Look at lib/finance/own-transfers.ts, the own-account proposal card (components/iou-card.tsx "Own account proposal"), the transaction drawer's "my own account Moneo doesn't track" option, and the home/overview prompt. Fix the class: the confirmation must apply to the identifier, not to one transaction. Keep undo: undoing the confirmation reverts all the transactions it reclassified. Check chat/voice paths that create the same proposal.

## Rules for every child
- Repo: Moneo (indkhan/Moneo). Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly (no comments in code, surgical changes, tests only for real behaviour, hit every surface, desktop + source install both work).
- Read the full GitHub issue first: `gh issue view <n> --comments`. Recheck the current tree before changing anything; reproduce first.
- Work only in your own worktree. Create a branch `t3/issue-<n>-<short-slug>` from current `origin/main` (`git fetch origin && git switch -c <branch> origin/main`). Commit each step in plain language, ending each commit message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- Other agents are working in parallel on other issues against the SAME shared moneo-qa test backend and QA app port 3100. So: never run `npm run qa:reset`, never `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`, never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, Docker project `moneo`). Set up the state your test needs with disposable users or rows you create and remove. If port 3100 is already serving another checkout, wait and retry later; never kill a process you didn't start.
- Mock AI, bank and Scalable. No real paid calls.
- Before finishing: `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`; plus `npm run build` for app/config changes; for UI changes use the verify-ui skill (light/dark/mobile screenshots) and attach the evidence to the PR.
- Push and open a PR to `main` with `gh pr create`, body: what changed and why, `Closes #<n>`, how it was verified. End the PR body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge. Don't create a new GitHub issue unless work is truly deferred.
- If a decision is genuinely ambiguous beyond what's written here, pick the option that best fits AGENTS.md, note it in the PR body, and continue.
- Final line of your reply: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

One "yes" on an own-account card now remembers that account. It marks every matching transaction, past and future, as an own transfer and doesn't ask again.

- **What it saves:** the account goes on the Accounts page under the accounts Moneo doesn't track. It's saved by IBAN, or by the name on the payment when the bank gave no IBAN.
- **What it marks:** imports and bank sync mark later payments automatically. A name match also needs the name in the payment text and no other IBAN on the row, so a refund that only carries your name is left alone. The other open "your own account?" cards for the same account are closed.
- **Undo:** undoing any one of those transfers in the transaction drawer reverts all the transactions the confirmation reclassified and forgets the account. Accounts you add by hand still undo one transaction at a time.
- **Chat and voice:** both use the same path as the card, so they behave the same.
- **Migration:** `202611160001_confirmed_own_accounts.sql` makes the IBAN optional and adds a name key and a "confirmed" flag. It uses no extensions, so it runs on the desktop app's Postgres.

**Verification:**
- Two new database tests (`lib/finance/own-transfers.live.test.ts`, run by `npm run test:db`) pass: one yes marks all, closes the other card and marks a later import, and one undo reverts all. The IBAN-less name case passes too.
- `lib/schema.live.test.ts`, lint and `tsc` are clean on my files.
- I applied the migration to the shared `moneo-qa` database for the tests and removed it afterwards. The test data is gone too.
- `npm test` has five failing files. Two need the `unpdf` package, which is missing from the `node_modules` I borrowed because `npm ci` kept stalling. The other three timed out under load and pass when run alone.

**Not done:**
- No light/dark/mobile screenshots and no `npm run build`. The only visible changes are one line of card text and a "matched by name" label in the Accounts list.
- Undoing a single transfer of a hand-added account still leaves that account saved, so the next import marks it again. That is the same as before.
